hints: Constant speed means zero net force. Which way does friction act on A in each case?
worded:
1. Constant velocity: forces balance, and T = m_B g.

2. A’s weight component down the slope: 50 N. Kinetic friction: 0.2 × 100 cos 30° = 17.3 N, opposite to A’s motion.

3. (i) A moving down: friction up the slope. T = 50 − 17.3 = 32.7 N, so m_B = 3.27 kg.

4. (ii) A moving up: friction down the slope. T = 50 + 17.3 = 67.3 N, so m_B = 6.73 kg.
mistakes: Friction’s direction flips with the direction of motion, so the two answers differ by 2f/g.
